check.update_combined: The update file holds several packages (base game, update or DLC in one file). Choose a dump that contains only the 1.0.1 update.
check.update_not_astral: The update file is not an Astral Chain update ({detail}).
check.exefs_failed: The game code of the {input} file failed its checks; see {log}.

check.update_wrong_version: The update is version {found}; this release takes {wanted}.

warn.lang_needs_fonts: Text in {lang} needs the Switch system fonts. Choose the firmware folder (Contents/registered) to install them; without it some text may not show.
warn.npdm_differs: main.npdm differs from the reference {version} dump; only the code modules are used.
warn.data_accepted: The game data differs from the reference dump (size {size}); carrying on because you asked. The game may not run.
warn.version_accepted: The game code differs from the reference dump ({modules}); carrying on because you asked. The game may not run.
warn.update_accepted: The update code differs from the reference {version} dump ({modules}); carrying on because you asked. The game may not run.
warn.cheats_skipped: The cheats of the mods folder that change the game's code could not be built; the game installs without them. Details: {log}
warn.exefs_skipped: The mods' ExeFS patches (.ips, .pchtxt) could not be built; the game installs without them. Details: {log}
warn.xbox_prompts_failed: The Xbox button prompts could not be prepared (exit code {code}); the game keeps the Switch prompts. Details: {log}
warn.shaders_skipped: The graphics driver crashed while building some shaders, so {count} were left out of the preparation. The game builds them when it first needs them, and the driver may crash there too; a driver update may fix it. Details: {log}
warn.kernel_old: Linux {version} lacks the write tracking the game relies on (6.7 or later); the game may run very slowly. Updating the system fixes this.
ui.title: Astral Chain Setup
ui.rebuild_title: Rebuilding the game for your mods
ui.intro: This setup turns your own copy of Astral Chain for Switch into a game you can play on this PC.
ui.notice: The folder this setup builds contains the game. It is for your own use only; do not share or upload it.
ui.keys_private: The keys file is read in place. Its contents are never shown, copied or stored.
ui.firmware_help: For Chinese, Korean and Traditional Chinese text: the firmware's Contents/registered folder, for example from Ryujinx or Yuzu. The setup copies the Switch system fonts from it into the install folder.
ui.continue_anyway_help: Your game files do not match the dump this build was made from. If you are sure they are the 1.0.0 base game and the 1.0.1 update, continue anyway: the game may run, or it may crash or show errors.
ui.missing_base: The base game file does not exist.
ui.missing_update: The update file does not exist.
ui.missing_keys: The keys file does not exist.
ui.missing_firmware: The firmware folder does not exist.
ui.done_text: Click Play to start the game. Later, start {game_exe} from {dest} (you can make a shortcut to it). The setup folder and the game files you chose are no longer needed.
ui.cancelled_text: The finished steps are kept. Start the setup again with the same folder to continue.
ui.confirm_cancel: The setup is running. Cancel it and close the window?
ui.space_one: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB).
ui.space_two: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB); on {temp}: {temp_need} GB (free: {temp_free} GB).
ui.welcome: What would you like to do?
ui.choice_install: Install the game for the first time
ui.choice_install_text: Choose this if the game is not installed on this PC yet. You need the game files from your Switch. The setup can take a while, depending on your computer, and runs only once.
ui.choice_update_text: Choose this if the game is already installed and you downloaded a newer setup. Just choose the game folder: your saves, settings and mods are kept, and the game files are usually not needed again.
ui.install_intro: Choose the three files from your Switch, then the folder where the game will go. A ✔ appears next to each file that is found.
ui.base_hint: The game itself (version 1.0.0), an .nsp or .xci file. Its name often contains 01007300020FA000.
ui.update_hint: The 1.0.1 update, an .nsp file. Its name often contains 01007300020FA800 or v65536. Filled in automatically when it sits next to the game.
ui.keys_hint: The keys of your Switch, dumped with Lockpick_RCM. Filled in automatically when found next to the game or in Ryujinx or yuzu.
ui.dest_resume: An earlier setup stopped in this folder: it continues where it left off.
ui.dest_is_file: The install location is a file. Choose a folder.
ui.dest_not_empty: This folder already holds other files. Choose an empty folder, or a new one: the setup creates it.
ui.dest_has_install: The game is already installed in this folder. To bring it up to date, update it instead.
ui.install_unreadable: The installation record {path} cannot be read. Choose another folder.
ui.update_intro: Choose the folder where the game is installed: the one that holds {game_exe}.
ui.pick_install_folder: Choose the folder where the game is installed
ui.need_install_folder: Choose the folder where the game is installed.
ui.no_install: No installed game was found in this folder. Choose the folder that holds {game_exe}.
ui.install_found: Installed game found: Astral Chain {version}, installed with setup {release}.
ui.install_unfinished: Its setup did not finish: it continues where it stopped.
ui.install_old: It was installed by an older setup, so the game files are needed one more time.
ui.install_same_release: It is already up to date. Running the setup again checks it and repairs what is missing.
ui.install_kept: Your saves, settings and mods are kept.
ui.files_needed: This time the setup needs your game files again. Choose them below.
ui.run_hint: You can keep using your computer. Leave this window open until the setup finishes.
ui.result_updated: The game is up to date
ui.updated_text: Your saves, settings and mods were kept. Click Play to start the game; you can delete this setup folder.
